note: Graveborn Barrow Stalker (unit identity, Graveborn): a solid blue-grey wedge, a shaggy fur cowl over a rimed skull with two soul-light eyes, a fur shoulder-cape over a knee-length frost felt mantle hemmed in violet icicle teeth, bare bone legs, a team wrap, the frost bow. Tier II iron plate with rime tines, tier III black gilt plate; no flag on the back, no antlers.
